targets.queryText: WITH requested AS (SELECT intent,version FROM intent_inputs WHERE active=1 ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1), applied AS (SELECT intent,version FROM a1_policy_summary WHERE active=1 ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT requested.intent AS requested_intent,requested.version AS intent_version,applied.intent AS active_policy_intent,applied.version AS policy_version,CASE WHEN requested.intent=applied.intent THEN 'active' ELSE 'generating' END AS policy_status FROM requested LEFT JOIN applied ON 1=1;
targets.rawQueryText: WITH requested AS (SELECT intent,version FROM intent_inputs WHERE active=1 ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1), applied AS (SELECT intent,version FROM a1_policy_summary WHERE active=1 ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT requested.intent AS requested_intent,requested.version AS intent_version,applied.intent AS active_policy_intent,applied.version AS policy_version,CASE WHEN requested.intent=applied.intent THEN 'active' ELSE 'generating' END AS policy_status FROM requested LEFT JOIN applied ON 1=1;

targets.queryText: WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(ts_ms) AS ts_ms FROM a1_policy_summary WHERE active = 1), age AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ts_ms IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(((julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 - ts_ms) AS INTEGER) END AS value FROM latest) SELECT CASE WHEN value IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN value < 0 THEN 0 ELSE value END AS last_a1_update_age FROM age;
targets.rawQueryText: WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(ts_ms) AS ts_ms FROM a1_policy_summary WHERE active = 1), age AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ts_ms IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(((julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 - ts_ms) AS INTEGER) END AS value FROM latest) SELECT CASE WHEN value IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN value < 0 THEN 0 ELSE value END AS last_a1_update_age FROM age;

targets.queryText: WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(ts_ms) AS ts_ms FROM ddpg_actions), age AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ts_ms IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(((julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 - ts_ms) AS INTEGER) END AS value FROM latest) SELECT CASE WHEN value IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN value < 0 THEN 0 ELSE value END AS last_ddpg_action_age FROM age;
targets.rawQueryText: WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(ts_ms) AS ts_ms FROM ddpg_actions), age AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ts_ms IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(((julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 - ts_ms) AS INTEGER) END AS value FROM latest) SELECT CASE WHEN value IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN value < 0 THEN 0 ELSE value END AS last_ddpg_action_age FROM age;

targets.queryText: WITH indications AS (SELECT ts_ms, MIN(recv_ts_ms) AS recv_ts_ms FROM kpm_measurements_raw GROUP BY ts_ms ORDER BY ts_ms DESC LIMIT 2) SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) < 2 THEN NULL ELSE MAX(recv_ts_ms) - MIN(recv_ts_ms) END AS kpm_update_interval FROM indications;
targets.rawQueryText: WITH indications AS (SELECT ts_ms, MIN(recv_ts_ms) AS recv_ts_ms FROM kpm_measurements_raw GROUP BY ts_ms ORDER BY ts_ms DESC LIMIT 2) SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) < 2 THEN NULL ELSE MAX(recv_ts_ms) - MIN(recv_ts_ms) END AS kpm_update_interval FROM indications;

targets.queryText: WITH latest AS (SELECT MIN(recv_ts_ms) AS recv_ts_ms FROM kpm_measurements_raw WHERE ts_ms = (SELECT MAX(ts_ms) FROM kpm_measurements_raw)), age AS (SELECT CASE WHEN recv_ts_ms IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(((julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 - recv_ts_ms) AS INTEGER) END AS value FROM latest) SELECT CASE WHEN value IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN value < 0 THEN 0 ELSE value END AS kpm_last_seen_age FROM age;
targets.rawQueryText: WITH latest AS (SELECT MIN(recv_ts_ms) AS recv_ts_ms FROM kpm_measurements_raw WHERE ts_ms = (SELECT MAX(ts_ms) FROM kpm_measurements_raw)), age AS (SELECT CASE WHEN recv_ts_ms IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(((julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 - recv_ts_ms) AS INTEGER) END AS value FROM latest) SELECT CASE WHEN value IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN value < 0 THEN 0 ELSE value END AS kpm_last_seen_age FROM age;

targets.queryText: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',bucket_ms/1000.0,'unixepoch') AS time,printf('%s | %d:%s',ue_id,sst,replace(sd,'0x','')) AS metric,AVG(dl_th_mbps) AS value FROM (SELECT CAST(ts_ms/100 AS INTEGER)*100 AS bucket_ms,ue_id,sst,sd,COALESCE(dl_th_mbps,0) AS dl_th_mbps FROM ue_slice_throughput WHERE ue_id!='slice-total' AND ts_ms>((julianday('now')-2440587.5)*86400000-120000)) GROUP BY bucket_ms,ue_id,sst,sd ORDER BY bucket_ms ASC;
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',bucket_ms/1000.0,'unixepoch') AS time,printf('%s | %d:%s',ue_id,sst,replace(sd,'0x','')) AS metric,AVG(dl_th_mbps) AS value FROM (SELECT CAST(ts_ms/100 AS INTEGER)*100 AS bucket_ms,ue_id,sst,sd,COALESCE(dl_th_mbps,0) AS dl_th_mbps FROM ue_slice_throughput WHERE ue_id!='slice-total' AND ts_ms>((julianday('now')-2440587.5)*86400000-120000)) GROUP BY bucket_ms,ue_id,sst,sd ORDER BY bucket_ms ASC;

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',bucket_ms/1000.0,'unixepoch') AS time,metric,AVG(dl_th_mbps) AS value FROM (SELECT CAST(ts_ms/100 AS INTEGER)*100 AS bucket_ms,printf('%d:%s',sst,replace(sd,'0x','')) AS metric,COALESCE(dl_th_mbps,0) AS dl_th_mbps FROM network_state WHERE ts_ms>((julianday('now')-2440587.5)*86400000-120000)) GROUP BY bucket_ms,metric ORDER BY bucket_ms ASC;

targets.queryText: SELECT printf('%d:%s', p.sst, replace(p.sd, '0x', '')) AS slice, p.dedicated_prb FROM applied_prb_policy p JOIN (SELECT plmn, sst, sd, MAX(ts_ms) AS ts_ms FROM applied_prb_policy GROUP BY plmn, sst, sd) latest ON p.plmn = latest.plmn AND p.sst = latest.sst AND p.sd = latest.sd AND p.ts_ms = latest.ts_ms ORDER BY p.sst, p.sd;
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT printf('%d:%s', p.sst, replace(p.sd, '0x', '')) AS slice, p.dedicated_prb FROM applied_prb_policy p JOIN (SELECT plmn, sst, sd, MAX(ts_ms) AS ts_ms FROM applied_prb_policy GROUP BY plmn, sst, sd) latest ON p.plmn = latest.plmn AND p.sst = latest.sst AND p.sd = latest.sd AND p.ts_ms = latest.ts_ms ORDER BY p.sst, p.sd;

targets.queryText: WITH ranked AS (SELECT ue_id,rnti,plmn,sst,sd,ts_ms,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ue_id ORDER BY ts_ms DESC,rowid DESC) AS rn FROM ue_slice_throughput WHERE ue_id!='slice-total') SELECT ue_id,rnti,plmn,sst,sd,printf('%d:%s',sst,replace(sd,'0x','')) AS s_nssai,ts_ms AS last_seen_ts_ms FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY ue_id;
targets.rawQueryText: WITH ranked AS (SELECT ue_id,rnti,plmn,sst,sd,ts_ms,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ue_id ORDER BY ts_ms DESC,rowid DESC) AS rn FROM ue_slice_throughput WHERE ue_id!='slice-total') SELECT ue_id,rnti,plmn,sst,sd,printf('%d:%s',sst,replace(sd,'0x','')) AS s_nssai,ts_ms AS last_seen_ts_ms FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY ue_id;
